qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant global heavy-duty turbocharger monopoly (>40% total market share, >70% in large marine engines) with unassailable switching barriers: turbocharger components operate under extreme heat (up to 1,000°C) and pressure where uncertified non-OEM parts void vessel insurance and engine warranties. Recurring aftermarket service contracts represent two-thirds of revenue, yielding 33%+ GAAP ROIC and 100%+ FCF conversion.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global heavy marine turbocharger monopoly with 66-75% recurring aftermarket service revenue, unreplicable warranty lock-in, and 33%+ GAAP ROIC. Net debt < 1x NI and >100% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: marine trade volume 3.5% + pricing power 2.0% + green dual-fuel upgrade mix 2.5% - supply chain capex drag 0.5% + dividend/buyback reinvestment 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Spun off from ABB with stellar capital allocation. FY2022-2025 track record: median GAAP ROIC is 33.4%, operating ROIC >37%, and Owner FCF conversion 102%. FY2025 net debt is $186M ($542M debt vs $356M cash) against $233M net income, repayable in under 1 year. Minimal interest expense ($0.3M). Primary beneficiary of IMO maritime decarbonization (retrofits for methanol/ammonia/LNG) and stationary power for data centers.
